title: ICANIAN P9 current enduro frame page
notes: The exact P9 page identifies Toray T700/T800 carbon and nominal tire sizes 27.5x3.0 or 29x2.3; an XD drivetrain narrows the 27.5 option to 2.5. Its stiffness language is qualitative (stiff in key zones, compliant on rough terrain) without a test protocol.
